Based on a precise visual comparison of the two images, here is the detailed breakdown of differences and similarities:

### 1) Position of Service Labels
*   **Top (Personal Branding):** **Match.** Centered horizontally at the top in both.
*   **Left (Marketing Automation):** **Match.** Positioned on the left side in both.
*   **Right (Lead Generation):** **Match.** Positioned on the right side in both.
*   **Bottom-Left (Sales Support):** **Match.** Positioned at the bottom-left in both.
*   **Bottom-Right (Cold Email Marketing):** **Match.** Positioned at the bottom-right in both.

### 2) Icons Inside Service Pills
All icons match perfectly between Image 1 and Image 2:
*   **Personal Branding:** Fingerprint icon.
*   **Marketing Automation:** Gears icon.
*   **Lead Generation:** Target/Bullseye icon.
*   **Sales Support:** Headset/Headphones icon.
*   **Cold Email Marketing:** Paper Plane icon.

### 3) Center Hub Icon
*   **Match.** Both images feature an identical "S-curve" or "link" style icon inside the central glowing circle.

### 4) Rings (Solid vs. Dashed)
*   **Match.** Both images contain **three concentric rings**:
    *   **Inner Ring:** Solid line.
    *   **Middle Ring:** Dashed line.
    *   **Outer Ring:** Solid line.
    *   *Note:* Both images also include faint dashed radial lines connecting the center to each of the five service labels.

### 5) Orbiting Dot(s)
*   **DIFFERENCE FOUND.**
    *   **Image 1:** The orbiting dot is located at the **12 o'clock position** (top), sitting on the outer solid ring directly below the "Personal Branding" label.
    *   **Image 2:** The orbiting dot is located at the **3 o'clock position** (right), sitting on the outer solid ring directly to the right of the "Lead Generation" label.

### 6) Other Visual Differences
*   **Context/Background:**
    *   **Image 1** is a full webpage screenshot including a navigation header (logo, menu links, CTA button), hero text ("Personal branding, lead generation..."), secondary action buttons, and a lower section ("WHAT WE DO").
    *   **Image 2** is a clean, isolated crop of just the orbit graphic on a dark background with no surrounding UI elements.
*   **Glow & Colors:**
    *   The colors (teal/cyan on dark green/black) and the glow effect on the center hub appear identical in hue and intensity between the two images.
*   **Chip Style:**
    *   The service label pills (rounded rectangles with borders) appear to have identical styling, border radius, font size, and padding in both images.

**Summary:** The graphics are functionally identical in design, icons, and layout, with the **sole difference being the current position of the animated orbiting dot** (Top in Image 1 vs. Right in Image 2).
